newsitem.title: USA: Dow off lows but sluggish, techs gain some ground.
newsitem.headline: Dow off lows but sluggish, techs gain some ground.

text.p: The Dow industrials languished at lower levels on Monday, depressed by a weak bond market and lingering concerns about higher rates and inflation after strong economic data released on Friday.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was off about 42 points at 8152 while the long bond lost 17/32 to yield 6.49 percent.
The Nasdaq composite rose three points to 1587 but its declining issues outpaced advancers by nine to eight.
"There's a continuation of Friday's nervousness, and the first day I've seen of the summer doldrums," said Frank Calta, managing director, institutional trading at Dain Bosworth.
